name: Witch Please: Sex Service
source:
Inherit a potion shop, a pile of debt, and a line of horny clients. Brew potions from lust, serve pleasure on demand, and uncover your father’s secret elixir. In this erotic witch sim, sex is currency — and you’re the main provider. 

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3676590//]Steam[/url]]
translation:
你继承了一家魔药店，也继承了一屁股债，还有一长队欲火难耐的顾客。用情欲调制药水，按客人的要求提供快感，揭开父亲秘密灵药的真相。在这款情色女巫模拟游戏中，性就是货币，而你就是最大的供应商。
